verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS email platform that also ships a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to disable telemetry, analytics or usage tracking. SOC 2 Type II compliance and scoped API keys are adjacent security controls, not a tracking opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
